reviews.comment: Nothing is online so you have to show up to lectures. The reviews he gave were basically 1:1 with the exams so as long as you showed up to lecture and paid attention, you will get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Material could be self-taught from the textbook, but the lectures were so informative and to-the-point it's better to just attend lectures instead. The exam content is based exactly on what is covered in class and he even gives reviews before each exam. He doesn't post lecture content on Canvas, which is not that bad imo

Tian Yang is the best professor I've ever had. He makes a hard class like MATH 304 feel easy because his teaching is flawless. Perfect explanations, clear board notes, and zero unnecessary busywork. You actually learn the content in class. If all professors were this good, you could finish a 4-year degree in one semester. Absolutely amazing.

Best math prof I've had in TAMU. If you show up to every lecture and take notes you'll be fine. I will say he makes his lectures more theoretical compared to other 304 profs, so if you don't like proofs then the class can get boring at times. Exams are almost identical to in-class work and he reviews the class beforehand. No reason not to get an A.
He's the best linear alg professor. His exams are exactly what he goes over in class and he also gives good reviews. No quizzes just HW. The exam median was like a 93.

Dr. Yang is a great choice for 323. He explains concepts very clearly and breaks down proofs with lots of examples. He reviews important test concepts before every exam, so it's very reasonable to do well.

Yang is a good prof, his lectures are overall pretty clear. It may take a little to adjust to his teaching style. His grading on tests was very generous, if students at least attempted all the problems they got an 80 minimum. Some homework was very long though and from the textbook.
Just a really really great guy that cares about his students and loves what he teaches.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are not recorded, and canvas was virtually empty except for homework submission & announcements. Go to his lectures! Tests are forgiving, and the textbook was only required for homework. Pretty easy class if you go to lectures, pay attention, and don't fall behind.

Have an A in the course but dropped because I'm only taking it for a minor that I won't be able to complete due to scheduling conflicts. Dr. Yang is the best math prof I've had. Very old school and just writes questions and notes on the board, but his logic flow is extremely easy to follow and is great for going back to during studying. Take him!!!
Generous with grading, lectures are clear

Bro easily the best prof I had at TAMU up to that point. Material isnt that difficult just show up to class and take notes. A few long homeworks but nothing that bad. He clearly covers the material and type of questions that will be on exam in class lecture so just go to class. Really nice prof and is generous with grading.

Lectures are extremely boring. Is okay at lecturing. However review sessions are quite helpful. Exams are tough but he grades them very nicely and fairly. One piece of advice would be to be able to calculate RREF's very quickly and accurately as that will boost your exam score.

Professor Yang has been one of the best math professors I've had at TAMU. His teaching style is very old-school, so make sure to show up to class. There is no content on his canvas other than the syllabus and your assignments. 

All in all, he is an amazing prof who makes one of the more conceptually difficult courses easy.

He can sometime be hard to understand but exams are like the reviews he goes over in class, he also works all of them out so you know how to solve them. Homework can sometimes be long but overall he is amazing.

Dr. Yang is the best linalg professor at A&M. Clear lectures with LOTS of examples, homeworks are generally not bad (except for 2-3 of them in the middle of the semester which are really long), and the best part, he gives review problems that are extremely similar to the exams. It is very difficult to screw up in his class. We love Dr. Yang

compared to what i heard about other profs, prof yang was super easy. he taught content well and gave clear steps on how to solve problems. his exam reviews are exactly like the exam. hw is harder than the actual exam material. no quizzes. 1st exam was hard due to time limit(50min), 2nd exam super easy, final is cumulative.
His lectures are very helpful and explain tough concepts well.

Tian makes harder concepts very easy to understand. The homework was always more complicated than the exams. He always did a review the class before an exam that's almost identical to the exam. My main complaint is that he was hard to reach outside of class and was terrible at responding to emails and answering questions.

Prof Yang made calc 3 easy. He explains things very well and legitimately cares that his students understand and perform well. He has a review session before every exam and goes over all the topics that will be on the test. Take his class if you have the option.

I don't think anyone could hope for a better math professor than Yang. He gives very clear lectures and goes out of his way to make sure his students know what's going on for the test. Make sure to go to class before a test, as he'll basically tell you everything you'll be tested on. Overall super cool, take him if you can.

He is honestly the best math prof I have ever had! His homeworks are once a week and not that bad, you can check your answers at the back of the book (but its the work that actually counts). He reviews the class before the test, and the reviews are VERY similar to the actual thing. If you can I HIGHLY reccomend you take him!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: As a course itself in Linear Algebra, the exams are time consuming so you have to work hard by hand without calculators. But his practice problems are so helpful and it is identical to the actual exams but different numbers. He grades very fairly and I practiced multiple times trying to make an A and made it through!
Dr. Yang is a fine choice. He clearly explains concepts in lecture, is very reasonable with homework load, and is great at interpreting and answering his students' questions.

Great professor, made Linear Algebra easy. Tests were exactly like the reviews he did in class. Took him at an awful time slot and didn't regret it at all, never struggled or worried about his class. Homework was very generous, generally didn't take more than an hour or so a week.

The G.O.A.T of 304 instructor. The class material will be conceptually hard to grasp after first midterm, but Yang is able to present the material so well by showing proofs of theorem along the way so that his students can understand. You should definitely take him for a decent grade and a decent learning experience!!!

Weekly homework consisting of textbook questions (except on exam weeks). The class before the exams, Professor Yang does a review of what to expect, usually the review is similar to the exam and is very helpful. I would recommend taking this professor for this course! I am expecting to get a B, but an A is not hard to achieve!

Weekly homework and 3 exams. He gives good examples during lecture and the class before an exam he works out practice problems. I took this class with a different professor and dropped it because I was making a C. Dif Eq is a difficult class but I highly recommend Tian.

Dr. Yang is a decent professor but I often had to teach myself material outside of class. The homeworks are very difficult but the tests are much easier so it's a trade-off. Fair grading for the most part on exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Yang for honors and had a really good experience in Linear Algebra. He speaks very clearly in his lectures, allowing students to understand complex topics relatively easily. His homework and exams are quite difficult but definitely help boost the understanding of the material.
I had Dr Yang for Linear Algebra Honors and thought he was really cool. He has helpful and great lectures and the homework assignments help a ton. He's very receptive to questions and is articulate.
Dr. Yang is a really good professor. His homework assignments are hard but he helps you understand the concepts really well. Hopefully I get him again!

Dr Yang is a really cool professor. He's pretty young so he vibes well with the class. He knows the material really well too and is really good at conveying the concepts. He does a lot of proofs so if you are proof minded like I am, you will find his lectures very helpful. There is a decent amount of homework too.

I had Dr. Yang for Linear Algebra (Math 304) and really enjoyed taking him. He gives good lectures and understands the concepts very well. He teaches from first principles thinking so you understand where concepts come from. Overall a respected professor and nice guy.
